ios.desc:
Mounjy is the all-in-one GLP-1 tracker built for people on weight-loss and type-2 diabetes injections. Log every shot, follow your dose plan, watch your weight trend, and stay ahead of side effects — all in one private, beautiful app.

Whether you take semaglutide or tirzepatide, Mounjy keeps your whole journey organized so you never miss a dose and always know what's normal for your body.

SHOT & DOSE TRACKING
• Log injections in one tap with date, time and injection site
• Follow a dose titration plan so you always know your next dose
• See your full shot and dose history at a glance
• Smart reminders so you never miss your weekly shot

MEDICATION LEVELS
• See estimated medication levels over time with a half-life curve
• Understand when your dose peaks and fades between shots

WEIGHT & PROGRESS
• Weight tracker with trend view and BMI
• Progress photos to see results beyond the scale
• Advanced charts for weight, doses and more

FOOD & PROTEIN LOGGING
• Find foods quickly with barcode scanning and a large food database
• Daily calorie and protein totals alongside your weight trend

SIDE EFFECTS & MOOD
• Log nausea, fatigue, appetite changes, mood and custom symptoms
• Spot patterns and keep clear notes for your healthcare provider

DOCTOR REPORT
• Export a clinician-ready PDF of your weight, doses and side effects
• Perfect for check-ups, refill appointments and telehealth visits

STREAKS & MOTIVATION
• Build logging streaks and earn badges as you stay consistent
• Compare your progress with published clinical trial results

SUPPLY & REFILLS
• Track your medication inventory and get refill reminders before you run out

APPLE WATCH, WIDGETS & LIVE ACTIVITY
• Apple Watch app with complications for your next dose
• Home-screen widgets for your next shot, weight and medication level
• Live Activity countdown on your Lock Screen on shot day
• Sync with Apple Health

PRIVACY FIRST
• Your data stays private on your device
• Biometric app lock (Face ID / Touch ID)
• Export your data anytime

Mounjy supports GLP-1 medications used for weight management and type-2 diabetes, including Ozempic®, Wegovy®, Mounjaro®, Zepbound®, Rybelsus®, Saxenda®, Victoza® and Trulicity®.

Health Disclaimer: Mounjy is for tracking and educational purposes only. It does not provide medical advice, diagnose conditions, or recommend dose changes. Always consult your healthcare provider for medical decisions.

quotes.text:
I built Mounjy for people using GLP-1 medications like Mounjaro, Zepbound, Ozempic, and Wegovy.

I wanted a more private, focused tracker for logging shots, weight, side effects, progress photos, reminders, and Apple Health data without needing another account.

Would love feedback, especially on the product direction, onboarding, and what feels missing for long-term GLP-1 tracking.

For anyone here who wants to try it, you can redeem 6 months free with code MOUNJYFREE in the app.
